brief.text: Maintains current and recent ledger validations.

content.text: Manages storage and queries related to validations received on the network. Stores the most current validation from nodes and sets of recent validations grouped by ledger identifier.
Stored validations are not necessarily from trusted nodes, so clients and implementations should take care to use
member functions or check the validation's trusted status.
This class uses a generic interface to allow adapting
for specific applications. The Adaptor template implements a set of helper functions and type definitions. The code stubs below outline the interface and type requirements.
The Adaptor::MutexType is used to manage concurrent access to private members of
but does not manage any data in the Adaptor instance itself.

content.text: Process a new trusted validation from a validator. This will be reflected only after the validated ledger is successfully acquired by the local node. In the interim, the prior validated ledger from this node remains.
